resampling.C1: exact area-weighted mean of Sentinel-2 over each 30 m cell, via 5 m sub-cells
resampling.C2: GDAL bilinear (warp), Sentinel-2 10 m to the 30 m Landsat grid
resampling.C3: GDAL nearest neighbour (warp), Sentinel-2 10 m to the 30 m Landsat grid
resampling.C4: Sentinel-2 exact 3x3 mean; Landsat GDAL cubic (warp) to the 30 m MGRS grid
resampling.angles: HLS 30 m angle layers averaged onto the Landsat grid (circular mean for azimuths)
resampling.landcover: WorldCover nearest neighbour to 5 m, dominant class per 30 m cell
resampling.masks: a cell is valid only if every contributing source pixel is valid; GDAL kernels grow the mask by their support

conditions.A_native: Native pixels (S2 10 m vs Landsat 30 m, overlap-weighted), S2 B08
conditions.C1_area_weighted: Common 30 m Landsat grid, S2 area-weighted mean, S2 B08
conditions.C2_bilinear: Common 30 m Landsat grid, S2 GDAL bilinear, S2 B08
conditions.C3_nearest: Common 30 m Landsat grid, S2 GDAL nearest neighbour, S2 B08
conditions.C4_hls_grid_cubic: 30 m MGRS (HLS) grid, S2 3x3 mean, Landsat GDAL cubic, S2 B08
conditions.C4_hls_grid_cubic_hls_clear_cells: C4 restricted to cells HLS Fmask also calls clear (the cells F uses)
conditions.D0_broad_nir_20m_support: C1 with S2 B08 first averaged onto B8A's 20 m pixels: B8A's spatial support, B08's spectral response
conditions.D1_narrow_nir: C1 with S2 narrow NIR B8A (20 m)
conditions.D2_narrow_nir_bandpass: D1 + HLS v2.0 bandpass adjustment of S2
conditions.E0_broad_nir_view_angle: C1 + c-factor view-angle normalization, S2 B08
conditions.E2_narrow_nir_view_angle_bandpass: E1 + HLS v2.0 bandpass adjustment of S2
conditions.F_hls_products: HLS v2.0 L30 vs S30 products (MGRS grid)
